ValidationRule.description: AM or PM across a multi-day range is meaningless. calculateLeaveDays already ignores Period_Leave__c on a range and counts whole days; this stops the employee believing otherwise.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName <> "Overtime_Request", NOT(ISBLANK(Term_To__c)), Term_To__c <> Term_From__c, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Period_Leave__c, "All day")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A half-day period can only be chosen for a single-day request. Set Period Leave to All day, or clear the end date.
